تتقاضي (form VI)
# تَتَقَاضَيْ (tataqāḍay) /ta.ta.qaː.dˤaj/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَقَاضَى (taqāḍā)
# تُتَقَاضَيْ (tutaqāḍay) /tu.ta.qaː.dˤaj/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَقَاضَى (taqāḍā)
